verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships transaction monitoring, so a rules engine with custom allow/block lists and velocity limits is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only covers selecting sanctions, PEP and watchlist screening lists, configurable risk-score equations, and transaction processing. None of these document user-maintained allow or block lists for emails, cards, devices or IPs, or velocity limits, whether in the dashboard or via the API. Third-party screening-list selection is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
